hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '(pixi\.lock|__pycache__|device_svg_files/|redis_settings\.json|\.pixi/)' && echo 'BLOCK: Generated or locked file' && exit 1 || exit 0
echo "$CLAUDE_COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git (checkout|reset|submodule).*(microdrop-py/src|src/)' && echo 'BLOCK: Do not modify submodule pointer directly' && exit 1 || exit 0

[ "$CLAUDE_AUTO_PYTEST" = "1" ] || exit 0; filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then basename=$(basename "$filepath" .py); testfile=$(find "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/microdrop-py/src/examples/tests" -name "test_*${basename}*" 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$testfile" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/microdrop-py" && pixi run pytest "$testfile" -x -q 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; fi
